title: Independently checked VLSAT-3 certificates and ground models
author: Takarashima, Kenshirou
competition_scope: SingleQuery published result records for the evaluated years 2021 through 2026. Year counts count records, including multiple records bearing the same solver name; they are not counts of distinct solvers. Never-solved means zero recorded successes in those evaluated years; it is not a claim of mathematical novelty or absence of solutions elsewhere.
